            return f"Not a git repository: {base}"

        commit_desc = f"{ctype.value}{scope_part}: {subject}"

            [commit_desc]

            return f"Nothing to commit. Working tree clean for {commit_desc}"

        commit_msg = CommitMessage(
            commit_type=ctype,
            scope=scope,
            subject=subject,
            body=body,
        )

        if dry_run:
            return f"[DRY-RUN] Would commit:\n{commit_msg.format()}"

        ok, msg = git.commit(base, commit_msg.format())
        if not ok:

        import os

        full_path = os.path.join(repo_path, target)
        if os.path.islink(full_path):
            raise OSError(f"Symlink rejected: {full_path}")
        with open(full_path, "w") as f:

        return full_path

        limit = max_chars or self._config.max_release_chars
        if len(changelog_content) <= limit:
            return changelog_content
        truncated = changelog_content[:limit]
        truncated += "\n\n... _(truncated due to platform limits. See full CHANGELOG.md in repo.)_"
        return truncated
